audit: forgegraph-syntax, -semantic, -planner, -codegen (library crates; forgegraph-cli is the native host). Searched for std::fs, std::env, std::process, std::thread, rayon, Instant/SystemTime, canonicalize, and checked dependencies (logos, rowan, toml, serde/serde_json, indexmap, sha2, hex): all pure Rust.
compilesForWasm32Before: yes: forgegraph-editor already builds syntax+semantic+codegen(+planner) for wasm32-unknown-unknown. Nothing failed to compile; the blockers are runtime behaviour on the check/build path, where wasm32-unknown-unknown's std::fs and std::env return Unsupported.
moduleImports: the resulting forgegraph_wasm.wasm imports nothing (no WASI, no JS glue)

blockers.what: std::fs::read_to_string for forge.toml, sources and dependency manifests; std::fs::read_dir + Path::is_dir to collect .forge files
blockers.handled: SourceTree trait (read, read_to_string, read_dir, canonicalize) with OsTree (std::fs) and MemoryTree (path -> bytes map, lexical . and .. folding). load_package(root) = load_package_in(&OsTree, root); signature unchanged for the CLI and LSP.

blockers.what: Path::canonicalize on the root and every path dependency for cycle detection and sharing
blockers.handled: moved to forgegraph-codegen::pipeline::load_tree over SourceTree::canonicalize. MemoryTree canonicalizes lexically, so symlinked packages are not unified as the OS would; acme has none.

blockers.what: std::fs reads of forge.lock and pinned extension manifests; std::process::exit(1) on a stale lock
blockers.handled: pipeline::lock_status returns Current/Missing/Stale and pipeline::verify_extensions reads through SourceTree; the CLI keeps its messages and exit codes, the wasm host reports them in JSON
pipeline::artifacts returns (relative path, contents) in the CLI's write order plus warnings; the CLI writes them, the Worker returns them
passed in as a parameter (sourceRevision in the wasm request)

blockers.what: eprint! of a failing dependency's diagnostics as a side effect
blockers.handled: pipeline::Error carries them (rendered()); the CLI prints them before the error, the wasm host returns them
not handled: not on the check/build path. Under wasm it would return an Unsupported error, not crash. forgegraph-editor already calls the importer without pins.

blockers.what: wasm32-unknown-unknown has no unwinding; a compiler panic traps and the Worker request throws
blockers.handled: not handled in this spike (no panic hook, no catch); acme does not panic

blockers.what: deployed Workers only advance Date.now()/performance.now() across I/O, and local workerd does not report per-request CPU time
blockers.handled: recorded in-isolate elapsed time (local workerd did advance its clock), client wall time, and Node V8 process CPU as a separately labelled proxy; workerd CPU ms recorded as missing

notFound: no threads, rayon, Instant/SystemTime, std::process or std::env in the library crates; no native-only dependencies
